title: Budget Too Low Details
description: Recommended details shape for BUDGET_TOO_LOW errors. Provides the seller's minimum budget so agents can adjust.

minimum_budget.description: Minimum acceptable amount for the constrained budget, in currency. budget_field identifies that budget when present; otherwise error.field can identify it only when it unambiguously names a budget control. If neither identifies the budget, this amount is diagnostic and buyers must reconcile current state before choosing a budget change. For a bid-dependent floor, report the computed required budget amount, not the bid value or the additional amount needed.

budget_field.description: JSONPath-lite locator for the constrained budget in the request's target scope, separate from error.field and issues[].pointer, whose existing semantics are unchanged. May name a retained budget omitted from an update. packages[i] always indexes a submitted request row, resolved through its package_id on updates, never a readback array index. Omit if the affected package has no submitted row or the budget cannot otherwise be located unambiguously; do not fabricate an index. Buyers must read and reconcile a retained budget before changing it.

basis.description: Period of the constrained budget identified by budget_field, or by error.field when it unambiguously names a budget control. daily does not imply hard-cap or averaged semantics. lifetime applies to a package or media-buy lifetime budget. Omission means undeclared; buyers must not infer a period from minimum_budget alone.

constraint.description: Cause of the budget floor, separate from its period. product_minimum identifies a seller's minimum for the selected product/pricing option; effective_bid_floor identifies a minimum computed from the effective bidding policy. Other non-empty values are permitted; buyers that do not recognize one can still use the amount, currency, period, and an unambiguous budget locator for recovery.

related_field.description: Request field path for an input contributing to the floor, using the same JSONPath-lite convention as error.field. For effective_bid_floor this identifies a buyer-authored bid that contributes to the computed minimum; budget_field separately identifies the constrained budget. Omit when no contributing request field can be identified; do not invent a path to a seller default.
